description: Source code for C++ code generation in PyTorch's JIT Tensorexpr, including classes for rewriting variable names, printing C++ code, and generating C++ kernels for tensor operations.

classes.name: CppVarNameRewriter
classes.description: Rewrites variable names to conform to C++ naming conventions by replacing '.' with '_'.

classes.name: CppPrinter
classes.description: Handles printing C++ code for tensor operations, including function prologue, variable declarations, and external calls.

classes.name: CppCodeGen
classes.description: Generates C++ code for tensor computations, including kernel function definition and invocation.

methods.name: printPrologue
methods.description: Prints the initial C++ includes, macros, and namespace declarations.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Various overloads for printing different tensor expression nodes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the code generator, applies variable name rewriting, and prints the kernel function signature.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Placeholder for invoking the generated C++ kernel.

methods.name: call_raw
methods.description: Placeholder for invoking the generated C++ kernel with raw pointers.
